title: Patch: a fuchsia outline on a Temporary 1 card in your hand, and a turns-left counter on every Temporary card there
thread:
**Issue #2437 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2437: Patch: a fuchsia outline on a Temporary 1 card in your hand, and a turns-left counter on every Temporary card there
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What it does

A Temporary card is discarded from its owner's hand once its count reaches 0 (R637, R2179001: each of its owner's end-of-turn cleanups takes 1 off; a plain Temporary is Temporary 1). Nothing in the hand shows how long a Temporary card has left, or warns that one is about to go. Make both visible, client only:

1. **The "about to be destroyed" aura, in fuchsia, on Temporary 1.** A face-up card in a hand whose view gives it Temporary with a count of **1** (discarded at its owner's next end of turn) wears the **Allure mark's aura** (`cards/CardMarks.tsx`, `cards/marks.css`: the vignette, the edge and the motes; R963, R1045000), recoloured **fuchsia**, the aura alone, the way #2270 drew Brittle's last count in gray (`CardMarks`' `bareAura`, `BRITTLE_LAST_COLOR`, #2403).
2. **A turns-left counter on every Temporary X card in a hand.** A face-up card in a hand that is Temporary (any count) shows a state-rail badge (`cards/cardState.ts`'s `stateBadges`, drawn by `cards/CardStates.tsx` and styled in `cards/cardstate.css`) with the count it has left, like Dormant's countdown badge (R1839000).

### Details, so the builder has nothing to decide

- **The count is the view's, never the printed number (CLAUDE.md rule 7).** The engine already writes the count left into the card's keywords (`layers::card_keywords` → `temporary::with_temporary_count`, R2179001): read the card view's `Temporary` keyword's `n`, a missing `n` counting **1** (plain Temporary). If a card somehow lists more than one Temporary entry, take the largest, as `temporary::temporary_number` does. Put that reading in one small helper (for example `temporaryLeft(keywords): number | null` in `cards/keywordVisuals.ts`, with a vitest test) and use it for both features.
- **Named constants (rule 9).** `TEMPORARY_LAST_COUNT = 1` beside `BRITTLE_LAST_COUNT` in `cards/keywordVisuals.ts`; `TEMPORARY_LAST_COLOR: MarkColor = "fuchsia"` beside `BRITTLE_LAST_COLOR` in `cards/marks.ts`, documented like it.
- **The palette.** Add a `fuchsia` entry to `MARK_PALETTES` in `cards/marks.ts`, after `gray`, with a `// #<this issue>` comment like gray's: `{ rim: "#e879f9", core: "#fae8ff", glow: "#a21caf", preset: "arcane" }`. It must stay distinct from Allure's `pink` (`#ff7ac8` / `#c2187a`).
- **Where the aura goes.** Only a face-up card in a hand (`game/Card.tsx` with `inHandOf` set and a card, `game/Hand.tsx`), on either seat that the view shows face up. Never a card back (the opponent's hand of backs carries nothing, R33/R437 as now), never the field, the resolving strip, the tray or the deck. Brittle's gray aura stays field-only (#2270) and is unchanged.
- **Precedence.** A real mark on the card (Allure, Duo, steal, the end-of-turn mark…) keeps its own aura and badge; the fuchsia aura is drawn only when the card has no mark of its own, exactly as `bareAura` already works.
- **The counter badge.** A new `StateBadgeKind` `"temporary"`: text `⌛{n}` (the glyph a named constant, `TEMPORARY_GLYPH`, like `DORMANT_GLYPH`), `data-temporary="{n}"`, its words (tooltip, accessible name, inspect line) through `t()`:
  - n = 1: `"Temporary 1: discarded at the end of its owner's turn"`
  - n > 1: `"Temporary {n}: discarded after {n} of its owner's ends of turn"`
  
  It goes in `stateBadges` right after the Brittle count (both end the card). The face model (`cards/model.ts`) carries the count only for a card in a hand, so a Temporary card that lands anywhere else shows no badge. Add both strings to the i18n catalogues the way other badge words are added (see `brittleWords`, `dormantWords`).
- **Motion** follows the marks' existing rules (moves under full motion, held still under reduced motion and `<html data-reduce-motion="true">`): reuse the existing `card-marks__*` CSS; no new aura CSS. The badge gets a disc colour in `cardstate.css` in the same fuchsia family (reuse the palette's values via the constants, or a CSS variable set from them; no new bare hex beyond the palette entry).
- No engine, card, spec or wire change: the view already carries the count. No new ruling; cite R637, R2179001, R963, R1045000 and #2270 in comments. Do not put an R-id in a new test's title (use `#<this issue>`), so `cargo jackioh spec check` does not expect the file in another ruling's `proven_in`.

## Acceptance

- Vitest (`apps/web/src/cards/CardMarks.test.tsx` or a new test beside `Hand`):
  - a hand card whose view has `Temporary` with no `n`, and one with `n: 1`, each render the aura with `data-mark-color="fuchsia"` and no `card-mark-badge`, no `data-marks`;
  - a hand card with `Temporary { n: 2 }` renders no fuchsia aura;
  - a hand card with Temporary 1 that also carries a real mark renders that mark's aura and badge, not the fuchsia one;
  - a Temporary 1 card on the field, in the resolving strip, and the opponent's hand of backs render no fuchsia aura;
  - `MARK_PALETTES.fuchsia`'s values are hex and differ from `pink`'s.
- Vitest for the badge (`apps/web/src/cards/cardState.test.tsx`): a hand card with Temporary (plain), Temporary 1 and Temporary 3 gets a `"temporary"` badge showing `⌛1`, `⌛1`, `⌛3` with `data-temporary` and the words above; a card with no Temporary, and a Temporary card off the hand, get none; the badge sits right after a Brittle badge.
- Vitest for the helper: no Temporary → `null`; plain → 1; `n: 2` → 2; two entries → the largest.
- The existing marks, keyword-visual and card-state tests still pass.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.

## Blocked by, part of

Nothing. Follows #2270 (the gray Brittle aura, shipped in #2403), whose `bareAura` prop this reuses.
```
